title: Delivery rates and retries
sqlTemplate: select max(counters_delivered) as delivered_total, max(counters_retried) as retried_total, max(counters_deadlettered) as dead_lettered_total, max(counters_duplicateobserved) as duplicate_observed_total from _frontend_observability_delivery_ops where service = 'telemetry-delivery-worker'
emptyDataSemantics: No telemetry-delivery-worker aggregate events in range renders NO_DATA; do not coerce to zero.
